name: Commonsense traps eval v2
description: Runs all 116 items of eval-commonsense-v2 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v3 id.

eval.notes: Adversarial by design: every item carries a surface pattern (a famous riddle, a 'healthy choice', a helpful-sounding count) that points at a wrong answer. Mixed scorers per row: multiple-choice rows carry `choices` and are scored with mc, the rest with numeric or exact. Always use the row's own `scorer` field; eval.scorer is only the default.

notes: accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right. Part of the second-generation (-v2) eval wave; there is no commonsense v1.
